overview_description.description: Local is a hospitality technology platform that enables venues across the GCC to offer seamless QR-code payments, ordering, loyalty programs, and customer analytics. The platform allows guests to scan, pay, split bills, and earn rewards directly from their phones without downloading an app. Local integrates with existing POS systems and supports payment methods such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and regional wallets. Designed for restaurants, hotels, cafés, and hospitals, the company focuses on improving operational efficiency, increasing customer retention, and delivering faster checkout experiences through smart payment infrastructure and real-time insights.
